generation_mode: imggen --backend codex --transparent (the owner's ChatGPT plan), one transparent master per status
derivation: alpha bounds (alpha > 8) cropped, longest side fitted to 62 px with Lanczos, alpha 250+ snapped to 255, centred on a 64 px transparent canvas
prompt_template:
A tiny status badge for an original fantasy strategy game's battle screen: {label}, a harmful status (the stack {does}). One finished square image, 1:1.

Subject: {subject}.
Composition: one single painted object, centred, filling about four fifths of the square, with a bold, simple silhouette that still reads when shown at 16 to 18 pixels; strong contrast between its light and dark parts; nothing else in the picture.
Background: fully transparent; no ground, shadow plate, frame, ring, circle or backdrop behind the object.
Style: richly painted original fantasy game art, painterly realism with crisp material detail and hand-painted texture, warm directional light, like a painted game item icon.
Constraints: an original design; no text, letters, numbers, runes that look like letters, watermark or UI elements; no symbols or designs from existing games or franchises.
